title: Workspaces
description: Vertical workspaces: a taskbar pager with hover previews, per-workspace names, keyboard switching, and "Send to workspace" on any tiled window. Extracted from the tiling core (#148). Every tiled column still lives on the one desktop core owns — this only decides which of them the strip draws — so turning it off simply shows every window on a single desktop, and turning it back on restores the groups. Enabled by default.
author: JohnConnorNPC
